item.title: Lesson 95: “I am One Self, united with my Creator.”
item.description: “I am One Self, united with my Creator.” Today’s idea accurately describes you as God created you.You are one within yourself, and One with Him.Yours is the unity of all creation. Your perfect unity makes change in you impossible.
